name: Bucharest Cubing Days 2021
information: COVID-19 Due to COVID 19 pandemic outbreak there are some restrictions and new rules in the venue. Following the organizers rules and the COVID 19 restrictions imposed by the authorities is mandatory. Using a protection mask accepted by the organizers is mandatory. Lunch Saturday and Sunday, will order pizza for lunch. The fee collector will ask you about pizza and you can give him the order. The pizza will be payed separated. Donations At the registration you can support the association "Asociatia Romana de Speedcubing" with a contribution and you will get a cubing prize. Prizes Certificates and medals for top 3 of each event.
